									</conditions>
									<actions>
										<do-if>
											<arg-conditions>
												<and>
													<if-xpath op="not-true">operation-data</if-xpath>
												</and>
											</arg-conditions>
											<arg-actions>
												<do-append-xml-element expression="." name="operation-data" />
											</arg-actions>
											<arg-actions />
										</do-if>
										<do-set-local-variable name="perm-attrs" scope="policy">
											<arg-node-set>
												<token-xpath expression="$perm-map-xml/mapping-table/row/col[last()]/text()" />
											</arg-node-set>
										</do-set-local-variable>
										<do-clone-xpath dest-expression="operation-data" src-expression="$static-map-xml" />
										<do-for-each>
											<arg-node-set>
												<token-local-variable name="perm-attrs" />
											</arg-node-set>
											<arg-actions>
												<do-set-local-variable name="permission-values" scope="policy">
													<arg-node-set>
														<token-op-attr name="$current-node$" />
													</arg-node-set>
												</do-set-local-variable>
												<do-append-xml-element expression="operation-data" name="permission" />
												<do-set-local-variable name="assignAttr" scope="policy">
													<arg-string>
														<token-local-variable name="current-node" />
													</arg-string>
												</do-set-local-variable>
												<do-set-xml-attr expression="operation-data/permission[last()]" name="name">
													<arg-string>
														<token-local-variable name="assignAttr" />
													</arg-string>
												</do-set-xml-attr>
												<do-set-local-variable name="entitlementDN" scope="policy">
													<arg-string>
														<token-map dest="entitlementDN" src="assignmentAttribute" table="..\PermissionEntMapping">
															<token-local-variable name="assignAttr" />
														</token-map>
													</arg-string>
												</do-set-local-variable>
												<do-set-local-variable name="entitlementObj" scope="policy">
													<arg-node-set>
														<token-query class-name="DirXML-Entitlement" scope="entry">
															<arg-dn>
																<token-local-variable name="entitlementDN" />
															</arg-dn>
														</token-query>
													</arg-node-set>
												</do-set-local-variable>
												<do-set-local-variable name="entitlementQualifiedDn" scope="policy">
													<arg-string>
														<token-xpath expression="$entitlementObj/@qualified-src-dn" />
													</arg-string>
												</do-set-local-variable>
												<do-set-xml-attr expression="operation-data/permission[last()]" name="entitlement">
													<arg-string>
														<token-parse-dn dest-dn-format="ldap" src-dn-format="qualified-slash">
															<token-local-variable name="entitlementQualifiedDn" />
														</token-parse-dn>
													</arg-string>
												</do-set-xml-attr>
												<do-set-xml-attr expression="operation-data/permission[last()]" name="dynamicResource">
													<arg-string>
														<token-map dest="resourceDN" src="assignmentAttribute" table="..\PermissionEntMapping">
															<token-local-variable name="assignAttr" />
														</token-map>
													</arg-string>
												</do-set-xml-attr>
												<do-strip-op-attr name="$current-node$" />
											</arg-actions>
										</do-for-each>
									</actions>
								</rule>

This DirXML rule triggers when a User object is deleted and the global variable 'drv.entitlement.onboarding' is set to 'true'. It processes entitlement removal by: (1) Creating an 'operation-data' element if it doesn't exist, (2) Loading permission attribute names from a mapping table ($perm-map-xml), (3) Cloning static mapping data, (4) Iterating through each permission attribute to build permission elements with entitlement details by querying DirXML-Entitlement objects and mapping assignment attributes to entitlement DNs and resource DNs, (5) Stripping the operation attributes after processing. This effectively removes all entitlements associated with the deleted user account.

<rule>

  <conditions>

      <arg-string>

      </arg-string>
    </do-set-local-variable>
    <do-for-each>
      <arg-node-set>
        <token-xpath expression="modify-attr" />
      </arg-node-set>
      <do-set-local-variable name="lvTmp" scope="policy">
        <arg-string>
          <token-xpath expression="$current-node/@attr-name" />
        </arg-string>
      </do-set-local-variable>
    </do-for-each>
  </actions>
</rule>

The broken XML violates the DirXML DTD by missing the required <arg-actions> element within <do-for-each>. In NetIQ DirXML, the do-for-each action requires two children: <arg-node-set> (the iteration source) and <arg-actions> (the actions to perform for each node). The broken version placed <do-set-local-variable> directly as a sibling instead of wrapping it in <arg-actions>. The corrected version properly nests the variable assignment within the required <arg-actions> container:

<do-for-each>
  <arg-node-set>
    <token-xpath expression="modify-attr" />
  </arg-node-set>
  <arg-actions>
    <do-set-local-variable name="lvTmp" scope="policy">
      <arg-string>
        <token-xpath expression="$current-node/@attr-name" />
      </arg-string>
    </do-set-local-variable>
  </arg-actions>
</do-for-each>

This DirXML rule handles Profile entitlement changes for User objects in an SAP system. It triggers when Profile entitlements are granted or revoked during modify operations, or when users are added. The rule determines the connector type (CUA-central, CUA-child, or standard SAP) and processes both removed and added Profile entitlements. For CUA systems, it manipulates the structured LOCPROFILES attribute (with SUBSYSTEM and PROFILE components). For non-CUA systems or when the entitlement matches the local system name, it manipulates the PROFILES:BAPIPROF attribute. The rule uses custom extension functions (es:getEntParamFieldBackwardsCompatible) to extract entitlement parameters like LSNAME (logical system name) and PROF (profile ID), handling both scenarios where the profile ID exists or the entire entitlement value is used.

content.text: Create a DirXML rule that removes SAP UM fanout associations during modify operations by checking if DirXML-Associations is changing, iterating through add-value entries with path components starting with 'fanout', querying the driver DN to get the DirXML-DriverId, and stripping the association if the driver ID is 'SAPUM'

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rule>
									<description>Strip SAP UM Fanout Association</description>
									<conditions>
										<and>
											<if-operation mode="case" op="equal">modify</if-operation>
											<if-op-attr name="DirXML-Associations" op="changing" />
										</and>
									</conditions>
									<actions>
										<do-set-local-variable name="assocNodeset" scope="policy">
											<arg-node-set>
												<token-xpath expression="modify-attr[@attr-name='DirXML-Associations']" />
											</arg-node-set>
										</do-set-local-variable>
										<do-for-each>
											<arg-node-set>
												<token-local-variable name="assocNodeset" />
											</arg-node-set>
											<arg-actions>
												<do-if>
													<arg-conditions>
														<and>
															<if-xpath op="true">$current-node/add-value/value/component[@name='path'][starts-with(text(),'fanout')]</if-xpath>
														</and>
													</arg-conditions>
													<arg-actions>
														<do-set-local-variable name="driverDN" scope="policy">
															<arg-string>
																<token-xpath expression="$current-node/add-value/value/component[@name="volume"]/text()" />
															</arg-string>
														</do-set-local-variable>
														<do-set-local-variable name="driver" scope="policy">
															<arg-node-set>
																<token-query datastore="src" scope="entry">
																	<arg-dn>
																		<token-local-variable name="driverDN" />
																	</arg-dn>
																	<arg-string>
																		<token-text xml:space="preserve">DirXML-DriverId</token-text>
																	</arg-string>
																</token-query>
															</arg-node-set>
														</do-set-local-variable>
														<do-set-local-variable name="driverId" scope="policy">
															<arg-node-set>
																<token-xpath expression="$driver/attr[@attr-name='DirXML-DriverId']/value/text()" />
															</arg-node-set>
														</do-set-local-variable>
														<do-if>
															<arg-conditions>
																<and>
																	<if-local-variable name="driverId" op="equal">SAPUM</if-local-variable>
																</and>
															</arg-conditions>
															<arg-actions>
																<do-trace-message>
																	<arg-string>
																		<token-text xml:space="preserve">Stripping off fanout association </token-text>
																		<token-xpath expression="$current-node/add-value/value/component[@name='path']/text()" />
																	</arg-string>
																</do-trace-message>
																<do-strip-xpath expression="$current-node" />
															</arg-actions>
														</do-if>
													</arg-actions>
													<arg-actions />
												</do-if>
											</arg-actions>
										</do-for-each>
									</actions>
								</rule>

content.text: Create a DirXML matching rule for User objects that implements Account entitlement with two branches: if drv.subPlacementType is 'flat', match by Given Name and Surname in subordinates of base container; otherwise, construct DN by taking substring from position 3 of unmatched-src-dn prepended with 'cn=' and appended to base container, using entry scope search.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rule>
									<description>match Users by CN</description>
									<conditions>
										<and>
											<if-class-name mode="nocase" op="equal">User</if-class-name>
										</and>
									</conditions>
									<actions>
										<do-if>
											<arg-conditions>
												<and>
													<if-global-variable mode="nocase" name="drv.subPlacementType" op="equal">flat</if-global-variable>
												</and>
											</arg-conditions>
											<arg-actions>
												<do-implement-entitlement>
													<arg-node-set>
														<token-entitlement name="Account" />
													</arg-node-set>
													<arg-actions>
														<do-find-matching-object scope="subordinates">
															<arg-dn>
																<token-global-variable name="driver.ldap.base.container" />
															</arg-dn>
															<arg-match-attr name="Given Name" />
															<arg-match-attr name="Surname" />
														</do-find-matching-object>
													</arg-actions>
												</do-implement-entitlement>
											</arg-actions>
											<arg-actions>

													<arg-actions>
														<do-find-matching-object scope="entry">

																<token-global-variable name="driver.ldap.base.container" />
															</arg-dn>
														</do-find-matching-object>
													</arg-actions>
												</do-implement-entitlement>
											</arg-actions>
										</do-if>
									</actions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rule>
									<description>AccountTracking - Merge and Migrate Operations</description>
									<conditions>
										<and>
											<if-global-variable mode="nocase" name="drv.acctTrk.enable" op="equal">true</if-global-variable>
											<if-class-name mode="nocase" op="equal">~drv.acctTrk.objectClass~</if-class-name>
											<if-xpath op="true">@from-merge = 'true'</if-xpath>
										</and>
									</conditions>
									<actions>
										<do-set-local-variable name="var-DirxmlFilterXML" scope="policy">
											<arg-node-set>
												<token-xml-parse>
													<token-replace-all regex="&lt;" replace-with="<">
														<token-base64-decode>
															<token-query class-name="DirXML-DriverFilter" datastore="src" scope="entry">
																<arg-dn>
																	<token-global-variable name="dirxml.auto.driverdn" />
																</arg-dn>
																<arg-string>
																	<token-text>DirXML-DriverFilter</token-text>
																</arg-string>
															</token-query>
														</token-base64-decode>
													</token-replace-all>
												</token-xml-parse>
											</arg-node-set>
										</do-set-local-variable>
										<do-set-local-variable name="var-LoginDisabledMergeAuth" scope="policy">
											<arg-string>
												<token-xpath expression="$var-DirxmlFilterXML//filter/filter-class[@class-name='User']/filter-attr[@attr-name='Login Disabled']/@merge-authority" />
											</arg-string>
										</do-set-local-variable>
										<do-set-op-property name="AccountTracking-MergeAuthority">
											<arg-string>
												<token-xpath expression="$var-DirxmlFilterXML//filter/filter-class[@class-name='User']/filter-attr[@attr-name='Login Disabled']/@merge-authority" />
											</arg-string>
										</do-set-op-property>
										<do-if>
											<arg-conditions>
												<and>
													<if-local-variable mode="nocase" name="var-LoginDisabledMergeAuth" op="not-equal">edir</if-local-variable>
												</and>
												<and>
													<if-local-variable mode="nocase" name="var-LoginDisabledMergeAuth" op="equal">edir</if-local-variable>
													<if-global-variable name="drv.entitlement.subAllowLoginDisabled" op="available" />
													<if-global-variable mode="nocase" name="drv.entitlement.subAllowLoginDisabled" op="equal">false</if-global-variable>
												</and>
											</arg-conditions>
											<arg-actions>
												<do-break />
											</arg-actions>
											<arg-actions />
										</do-if>
									</actions>
								</rule>

This rule handles Account Tracking during merge and migrate operations. It first checks if account tracking is enabled, the object class matches the configured tracking class, and the operation is a merge (from-merge='true'). If conditions are met, it queries the driver filter configuration from eDirectory, parses the base64-encoded XML, and extracts the 'Login Disabled' merge authority setting. It stores this in both a local variable and an operation property. Finally, it evaluates whether to break execution based on whether the merge authority is NOT 'edir', OR if it IS 'edir' but the subscription allows Login Disabled (drv.entitlement.subAllowLoginDisabled) is false. The rule prevents processing when merge authority conflicts with entitlement settings.
